messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we have an AWS Marketplace listing intake window next month and partner security wants a joint statement on SAML SSO + KMS support. Need to agree on scope and PM owner.
kai: I can own the technical spec for SAML + KMS integration. Is the ask: doc + demo + SOC-approved KMS flow?
maya: Product wants a short matrix: which plans support SAML, SCIM, KMS HSM. Also a recommended customer journey (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
shaun: Legal needs the wording for the joint announcement. Also checklist on encryption at rest key ownership and indemnities.
liam: From bizdev/marketplace side: AWS requires a security compliance blurb and screenshots of SSO in the listing. They also want a partner contact and timeline.
elaine: Ok — proposed deliverables: 1) Technical spec for SAML + SCIM + KMS (owned by kai), 2) Announcement draft (shaun + maya), 3) Marketplace assets (liam), 4) Implementation checklist for customers (maya). Deadline: two weeks before intake window.
kai: For the KMS bit — we should show two modes: Customer-managed key (bring-your-own-KMS) and Redwood-managed key. For BYOK, include sample YAML for key metadata and a short note about key rotation.
maya: Can you add a short snippet we can use in docs and the marketplace listing? e.g., "Bring your own KMS (AWS KMS/HSM) for tenant-key encryption"
shaun: Draft announcement: keep it high-level and compliant. I'll redline. Please avoid implying FedRAMP or attestations we don't have.
liam: Marketplace bot pinged: marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Listing intake opens 2026-11-05. Required assets: security description, 3 screenshots, contact, lead time"
elaine: Kai — can you paste a tiny example of SAML metadata elements we intend to support (so docs can use it)?
kai: Sure — use this example in docs: <entityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/saml">...AssertionConsumerService Location="https://redwood.example.com/auth/saml/callback"... </entityDescriptor>
(note: real metadata will be generated per tenant)
maya: Also add SCIM provisioning notes: we support SCIM 2.0 with groups and user attributes mapping. Include mapping table later.
shaun: For the announcement, propose language: "Redwood now supports SSO via SAML and customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM) for private deployments" — I'll refine.
liam: Marketplace needs a one-liner for security: "SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and optional customer-managed KMS for tenant encryption" — ok to use?
aielaine: small correction: "aielaine" was a typo in prior message. ignore.
elaine: yes that's fine, liam. Next steps: kai, drop the tech spec draft in this thread by EOD Thursday. shaun + maya start announcement outline and I'll schedule a 30-min sync with AWS marketplace team early next week.
kai: On it — will include sample config, key policy example, and a short FAQ about KMS access patterns.
maya: I'll sketch the customer journey and a 1-page implementation checklist.
shaun: I'll prepare redlines and a compliance pre-checklist for the marketplace listing.
liam: I'll prepare the listing template and ask AWS for preferred screenshot dimensions.
marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Reminder: upload assets to partner portal by 2026-11-01 to make the intake window."
elaine: Thanks everyone. If any blockers surface, ping me or drop in #eng-security.
kai: FYI — one technical risk: for BYOK in Dedicated, rotation without downtime needs coordination with instance KV caches. I'll document the migration pattern.
maya: Good call. Add that to the checklist as a risk/mitigation.
shaun: Also capture the customer-facing key ownership options clearly so sales doesn't overpromise.
liam: Scheduling the marketplace sync — invite sent for Mon 09:00 PT.
elaine: Thread closed unless urgent replies. :thumbsup:
